objective: Exercise digest-bound evidence acceptance: a builder produces an artifact digest and an independent reviewer binds acceptance to that exact digest.
constraints: Evidence-only canary; no repository:write and no cloud:change.
No LLM dispatch, no paid provider calls, no secrets in artifacts.
Resources are abstract lane names only; never absolute host paths.
Reviewer identity must differ from builder identity.

tasks.title: Produce a digest-bound evidence artifact
tasks.instructions: Write a deterministic JSON body under score-runs/{run_id}/evidence-binding.json. Return strict JSON with path and sha256. Do not mutate any repository or cloud resource.

tasks.title: Bind acceptance to the exact artifact digest
tasks.instructions: Verify the SEB-build artifact bytes match the claimed sha256, confirm the binding names the same run and task attempt, and return an acceptance_report. Fail closed on digest mismatch or self-review.
